bias.en: Bearish · lost the 200-day, recovered from a dip to $229
bias.zh: 偏空 · 跌破 200 日均线，自 $229 低点回升

read.en: Amazon slipped 1.4% on Oct 30 to $240.35, trading between $229.36 and $241.55 on 2.8 times average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($248.2), 10-day ($252.7) and 30-day ($253.0) averages and the rising 100-day ($251.8) and 200-day ($243.4). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 23 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 22 ($260.94), and RSI is 38.
read.zh: 亚马逊 10月30日小跌 1.4%，收于 $240.35，盘中区间 $229.36–241.55，成交量为均量的 2.8 倍。股价低于下行的 5 日（$248.2）、10 日（$252.7）和 30 日均线（$253.0）以及上行的 100 日（$251.8）和 200 日均线（$243.4）。MACD 自 10月23日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月22日起看空（$260.94），RSI 为 38。

read.en: The Oct 29 drop broke all three written supports, down to $243.4–244.7 (200-day, September lows), now resistance; Oct 30 dipped to $229.4 before recovering. Resistance is $243.4–244.7, then $248.2–249.1 (5-day, Oct 29 high) and $252.7–253.0 (10 and 30-day). Support is $229.4 (Oct 30 low), then $224.7–226.2 (Jun 25, Jul 29 and Jan 2 lows). A close above $244.7 would target $248–249; below $229.4, $225–226.
